lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: Nix, wake up! [beat] You can't just stare at the screen while the air in this server room is literally turning blue and humming like a jet engine!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I don't know who you are... [beat] but the monitor says 'Initialization 40%' and my head feels like it is being erased with a sandpaper block.

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: It is the school’s neural-link! [beat] Principal Huda isn't just filing grades... she's actually rewiring our memories to forget what we saw in her office!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: I told you children that curiosity has a very steep price... [beat] and unfortunately for you, your loyalty is currently being downloaded and replaced.

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: You are a monster, Huda! [beat] You can't just delete our personalities to make us the perfect straight-A students for your upcoming school inspection!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Tuli... I see names flashing on the screen. [beat] It's not just us... the whole school is on this list, even Bruno and Mr. Kamal are being targeted!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: A quiet school is a successful school. [beat] Once the reboot hits one hundred percent, you will both walk out of here and thank me for the detention.

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: The override code! [beat] I remember Nix saying he hid it in his gamer tag... Nix, think! What was the name you used to beat Riku last summer?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I can't... [beat] every time I try to remember a game, all I see is a white void and a spinning loading icon right in the middle of my vision!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Ninety percent complete. [beat] Say goodbye to your rebellion, because the 'New Student Initiative' is officially going live in exactly five seconds!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: Wait... the cables! [beat] If I can't stop the software, I will just destroy the hardware with this fire extinguisher I found under the metal desk!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Don't you dare touch that server! [beat] If you force a manual shutdown now, you won't just lose your memories... you will fry your entire brain!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Tuli, look at the screen! [beat] It is not a reboot... it is a broadcast! The files are being uploaded to every single phone in the city right now!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: Oh no... [beat] if that data gets out, it won't just be Huda who is in trouble... it is every single parent in this town!
